derivation:
rw [ModularForm.E₆, EisensteinSeries.E_qExpansion_coeff (by norm_num) (by decide) n]
split_ifs <;> (first | exact ⟨1, by simp⟩ | exact ⟨-(2 * 6 / bernoulli 6) * (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 5 n : ℚ), by push_cast; ring⟩)
explanation: The Mathlib lemma gives the coefficient formula for the normalized Eisenstein series at any even weight k ≥ 3. Specializing to k = 6 and unfolding E₆ gives the constant coefficient 1 or a rational multiple of the integer-valued divisor sum; the target proof uses this lemma directly.
